title: Ars Nouveau x Tensura: Reincarnated Compatibility
description: Compatbility mod for Ars Nouveau (and Ars Elemental) x Tensura: Reincarnated
body:
This datapack adds a compatibility for Ars Nouveau (and Ars Elemental) x Tensura: Reincarnated by adding EP to tools and gear, skills and ep to entities and other miscellaneous stuff.

**Ars Nouveau**

Added EP to all of its tools and gears. 
Added the Wilden Chimera as a non possessable, non charmable entity, as a boss for hero awakening and counting for boss kills for race requirements. 
Wilden Chimera, Guardian and Stalker drops Medium Quality Crystals when killed.
Added a loot table for the Wilden Boss to drop:
- 1 High Quality Crystal
- 1 Elemental Essence
- 8 Monster Leather A

Added EP and skills to entities:
- **Amethyst Golem** (2500-3000 EP + Magic Resistance)
- **All the Weald Walkers** (6000-9000 EP + Magic Resistance)
- **Drygmy** (2500 - 3000 EP + Magic Resistance, Universal Perception and Thought Acceleration)
- **Starbuncle** (2500 - 3000 EP + Magic Resistance and Thought Acceleration)
- **Whirlspring** (2500 - 3000 EP + Magic Resistance and Thought Acceleration)
- **Wilden Guardian** (3000 - 4500 EP + Magic Resistance, Water Breathing, Strenghten Body and Thought Communication)
- **Wilden Hunter** (3000 - 4500 EP + Magic Resistance, Coercion and Thought Communication)
- **Wilden Stalker** (3000 - 4500 EP + Magic Resistance, Sense Soundwave and Thought Communication)
- **Wilden Chimera/Boss** (175000 - 265000 + Pain Resistance, Physical Resistance, Paralysis Resistance, Self-Regeneration. Abnormal Condition Nullification, Strenghten Body, Steel Strenght, Magic Resistance, Ultra-Instinct and Berserker)

**Ars Elemental**
_Not required for the datapack to work._

Added EP to its armors (min EP: 225.000 and max EP: 750.000)

_Do leave feedback if specifics parts of the datapack are unbalanced.
Do leave suggestions._
